title: Agent Allowlist Framework: basis document of an entry
description: What one entry rests on. Its keccak256 over the RFC 8785 form is Entry.basisHash

subject.description: The object the entry is about. May be left out: the entry itself identifies it

basis.description: DESIGNATION: the manager's own choice, which asserts nothing about the subject. EVIDENCED: a statement of fact about the subject

status.description: EVIDENCED: how settled the stated fact is
